description: Historical rule-set evaluation over daily bars: net return, win rate, max drawdown and trade count for the latest window (in-sample) and the window before it (out-of-sample walk-forward); optional Monte Carlo block-resample distribution. Computed data, not a performance promise. Paid via x402 ($0.05 USDC on Base) when a payer wallet is configured; otherwise returns the payment requirements.
